text: In Tamil Nadu, income certificates can be applied through the TNeGA e-Sevai portal. Applicants usually need Aadhaar, ration card, and proof of income details. Track status using the application number on the same portal.

Caste and community certificates are available through the Tamil Nadu e-Sevai system. Applicants should provide identity proof, address proof, and relevant supporting records based on category requirements.

Birth certificate services in urban local bodies are available through Tamil Nadu urban e-governance platforms. Citizens can search records and download certificates where digitized records are available.
Land record related services such as Patta and Chitta can be accessed through Tamil Nadu government e-services. Users need district, taluk, village, and survey details to search records.
